purpose: Machine-readable provenance for corpus audits: the search vocabulary, the files and counts it hits, and the disposition recorded for each. Positive findings are reproducible from the repaired text; NEGATIVE findings -- the axes an audit reports as clean -- become reproducible too, which prose alone cannot deliver. verification/lean/audit_census_probe.py re-runs every entry and fails on any drift.
on_drift: A mismatch is not automatically a defect: the corpus moves. Re-read the location, decide whether the audit's disposition still holds, and update `expect` in the same commit as the text change, with the reason in the commit message. Never widen a pattern to make a mismatch go away.
